description_nl: The ledger is BODY-FREE: `#/reset?token=…` is stored as `#/reset`. Everything from the first of cut_at goes. 2026-09-23: a public film link (/w/<token>.mp4) is kept as /w/*.mp4 - the token IS the secret.
weight_basis: Platform operations primitive, no business content. The knobs ARE the policy — edit them here, never in Python.
